en: Black-and-white view of a Baroque church with an ornate façade, arched doors, statues in niches, and a tall clock tower rising behind it. To the right stands a high column topped with a statue of the Virgin and Child, enclosed by a low wrought-iron fence. Adjacent to the church is a long, plain building with many identical windows and shutters, facing onto a cobbled square or courtyard. The corners of the image are darkened as if from an old photographic plate, and there is a small strip with faint handwritten text at the bottom.
